fact: Decree-Law 1/2024 of 8 March makes the beneficial owner declaration a registrable act at CREL, due by 6 June 2024, and it can be filed remotely on the CREL submission portal for 300 MT, though the portal was still being harmonised for final approval.
title: O Beneficiário Efectivo ao abrigo do Regulamento do Registo de Entidades Legais, aprovado pelo Decreto-Lei n. 1/2024, de 8 de Março
